a: Unique IDs can use UUIDs, snowflakes, or DB sequences.
Snowflake IDs embed time and worker identity in 64-bit values.
Virtual nodes improve balance on a consistent hash ring.
Secondary indexes support queries beyond the primary key.
Write amplification multiplies write load due to compaction/replication.
Read repair fixes divergent replicas during reads.
Hinted handoff temporarily stores writes for down nodes.
Merkle trees efficiently detect and sync data differences.
Gossip protocols spread membership and state peer-to-peer.
Vector clocks track causal history across replicas.
